# Vasilis Totskas — Fullstack Developer

> Personal portfolio of Vasilis Totskas, a fullstack developer based in Athens, Greece. He develops applications for web, desktop and mobile, and builds the infrastructure that runs them.

Working professionally since 2019 — freelance until 2020, and at Advisable since. He holds a Computer Engineering degree from the University of Western Macedonia and is certified by Google and TestDome. He works in English and Greek, and the site is published in both.

The work groups into four layers. Interface: Vue.js, Nuxt (v3/v4), TypeScript and Tailwind CSS daily, plus JavaScript, React, Next.js, Vite, HTML and CSS. Services: Python, Django, Django REST, Go and PHP daily, plus NestJS and Node.js. Data: PostgreSQL and Redis daily, plus Meilisearch, RabbitMQ and Celery. Platform: Docker, Kubernetes (k3s), Linux and Git daily, plus ArgoCD, Nginx, Cloudflare, Hetzner, Vercel, Longhorn and Cert-Manager.

## Projects

- [Webside.gr](https://webside.gr): Production e-commerce store powered by GrooveShop, running every layer on a self-hosted Hetzner k3s cluster with ArgoCD, Longhorn, RabbitMQ, Celery, Redis and Cert-Manager
- [GrooveShop demo](https://demo.grooveshop.space/): Live demo of the GrooveShop platform
- [GrooveShop API](https://github.com/vasilistotskas/grooveshop-django-api): Django REST backend — business logic, auth and data
- [GrooveShop storefront](https://github.com/vasilistotskas/grooveshop-storefront-ui-node-nuxt): Nuxt 4 storefront with SSR, proxying to the Django API through Nitro
- [GrooveShop media stream](https://github.com/vasilistotskas/grooveshop-media-stream): NestJS image processing and media delivery microservice
- [GrooveShop agent gateway](https://github.com/vasilistotskas/grooveshop-agent-gateway): Go service making every tenant storefront shoppable by AI agents over MCP, with UCP/ACP surfaces, product feeds and a chatbot backend
- [GrooveShop infrastructure](https://github.com/vasilistotskas/grooveshop-infrastructure): Kubernetes manifests and GitOps configuration for the platform
- [This portfolio](https://github.com/vasilistotskas/nextjs-portfolio): Next.js 16, React 19 and Tailwind v4 in two languages, with a WebGPU hero rendered through vgpu
